rule: In a lesson the expected word is accepted when its share reaches its limit, whatever the largest share is.
attribution: Limits chosen on hand landmarks of recordings of the PopSign ASL project (Starner et al. 2023, CC BY 4.0): landmark recordings taken from the asl-signs rerun set, and captures of PopSign ASL v1.0 game clips replayed through the page. Not endorsed by the dataset authors.

provenance.status: candidate; used only when the page is asked to

sources.use: landmark recordings of the validation participant
sources.source: Kaggle dataset sohier/461054610546105 (rerun test data of the competition asl-signs)
sources.license: CC0: Public Domain per Kaggle metadata, read 2026-11-13; recordings of the PopSign ASL project (CC BY 4.0)

sources.use: captures the page made from replayed clips
sources.source: PopSign ASL v1.0, game category (train- and validation-folder clips, replayed through the page)

provenance.remark: Written again on 2026-11-14 with the same inputs and rule as the first file of that day (SHA-256 80473a8aeca7c4b948902c698471c81f27622bf9791cdb349f7acd05791ed09c), to add the licence, the attribution and the sources; the limits are the same. The 248 clips had been replayed with this network before, and the captures of all 25 participants have since been listed one by one, so the participants not named here are the held-out half of a development clip set and not an untouched test; a new fit would no longer be blind to them.

chosenOn.what: the captures of participant 6927 in the landmark cache, on which the network was not trained (the participant that chose its passes and threshold), and captures the page made from replayed clips of 13 other participants

fromReplayedClips.source: PopSign ASL v1.0, game category (train- and validation-folder clips, replayed through the page)
fromReplayedClips.participantsPickedBy: every second participant number of the 25 in ascending order, starting with the first; the other 12 score the limits

provenance.how: per word the lowest value of 0.05 to 0.95 at which at most 0.01 of the captures that are not that word would be accepted as it
provenance.note: The captures that are not the word are other words and other signs, not poor attempts at the word. A few hundred captures are a small sample. No live-camera figure.
